prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints, preset customization fallback flow, interactive wait tips/stage flow, pre-path story reordering, hotkey setup screen, and quick-action redesign were helpful.
Copy updates, layout changes, and hints outside of sign-in showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most new screens and new flows showed no clear effect or hurt performance, with the exception of the hotkey setup screen and specific wait/fallback flows.
Predictions overestimated gains for changes that showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Predictions underestimated gains for unexpected winning changes with negative or low predictions, such as the hotkey setup screen, quick-action redesign, story reordering, and waiting stage flow.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Data Preservation Recovery Hint: Adds an explicit account data preservation hint below sign-in options clarifying that signing in recovers and locks in saved pet data across sessions. (why: Top support theme with 8 tickets involves pets missing or reset after signing back into an account.)
1: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Action Quick Check Redesign: Redesigns the home intro screen into a checklist layout featuring interactive buttons to practice pet summoning, hiding, and basic hotkeys. (why: Finish step takes a high mean time (5815s) and support received multiple complaints from users confused about pet controls post-onboarding.)
2: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Processing Trait Feedback Wait Stage: Displays stage progress and visual processing feedback directly on the photo upload screen during pet asset generation. (why: Adoption stage takes a mean 1017s and users write to support when custom generation stutters or produces unexpected results.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Existing Pet Sync Headline Update: Updates sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly state that logging in restores and preserves existing pet progress. (why: Addressing 8 support emails concerning lost pets or account resets when signing in.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Generation System Tray Notification: Enables system tray notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted the moment their pet finishes loading. (why: Home wait time has a high mean (2336s), suggesting users switch away from the app while waiting for rendering to complete.)

scores.note: Sign-in hints consistently perform well in past tests (+2.2%) and address the top support issue.
Quick-action redesign targets high finish drop-off/time and is a proven historical winner (+5.1%).
Wait stage feedback targets the largest funnel drop step (37.3%) and aligns with lesson learnings.
Copy updates consistently show negative or neutral performance despite support ticket alignment.
Notifications mitigate long home step wait times and showed positive measured results in initial tests.
